I added `currency: str = "USD"` to `Config` in `ledger/config.py`. The existing tests pass (4 passed), but I didn't add a test for the new field.

It is set through `ledger.toml` (`currency = "EUR"`), like `db_path` and `rates_url`. `config.load` picks up any `Config` field from the file, so it needed no other change.

I did not add an environment-variable override. `docs/DECISIONS.md` says all settings are file-only, because a stray env var once pointed production jobs at a test database.
